gtfsUrl.description: The GTFS zip URL that was validated, echoed from the request.

currentTimeMillis.description: Server-side wall-clock time (milliseconds since the Unix epoch) at the moment validation ran. Shared by all feeds in the response.

feeds.description: One entry per URL in the request's gtfsRtUrls, in the same order.

gtfsRtUrl.description: The GTFS-realtime URL this result corresponds to.

feedTimestampSeconds.description: The feed header.timestamp value (seconds since the Unix epoch). 0 when the protobuf has no header.

results.description: One entry per validation rule that produced one or more findings against this feed.

skippedRules.description: Rules that threw an exception while evaluating this feed. Their findings are not included in results.

errorId.description: Stable identifier for the rule (e.g. 'W001', 'E002'). See RULES.md.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the rule.

description.description: Longer human-readable description of what the rule checks.

suffix.description: Sentence fragment appended to each occurrence's prefix to form the full message. Example: 'does not have a timestamp'.

occurrences.description: Per-entity prefixes, e.g. 'trip_id 277716'. Build the full message as `prefix + " " + suffix`.

name.description: Simple class name of the validator that threw, e.g. 'TimestampValidator'.

exceptionClass.description: Fully qualified class name of the thrown exception.

message.description: Exception message; may be null if the thrown exception had none.
